subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For an incomplete current attempt with a replay-unsafe tool call and no payload, should OpenClaw quarantine the attempt and continue with a repaired transcript, or retain the current terminal-error behavior until a generic tool-outcome reconciliation contract exists?
rationale: The safest treatment changes the product contract for session continuity after an uncertain side effect; the supplied reports show impact but do not establish whether retry, quarantine, or forced session termination is the intended operator experience.

options.title: Adopt quarantined recovery
options.body: Persist a structured incomplete-attempt record, prevent unresolved tool state from entering later prompts, and continue only when the tool outcome is known or safely summarized.

options.title: Keep terminal behavior
options.body: Continue surfacing an error for replay-unsafe current attempts while adding diagnostics that make the session boundary and recovery procedure explicit.

options.title: Design a generic reconciliation contract first
options.body: Define how all providers and tool runtimes report started, completed, and unknown tool outcomes before changing retry or transcript behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt quarantined recovery
recommendation.body: Persist a structured incomplete-attempt record, prevent unresolved tool state from entering later prompts, and continue only when the tool outcome is known or safely summarized.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related work directly examined the current-attempt versus cumulative replay-safety boundary, making them the strongest available technical routing candidate in the supplied history.
